text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takarazuka Kinen. 
Spectators remark on how high the 
competition has been lately, looking 
forward to today's race with great 
anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen field included G1 
winner Agnes Digital and Classic Double 
Crown Umamusume Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City has likely grown even 
stronger since the Arima Kinen. Wary of 
the threat, Symboli Kris S prepares to 
take on the Takarazuka Kinen.
